**The universe.**

Not in some vague inspirational way. The actual mechanics of it—why it exists, what it's made of, how consciousness flickers into being inside bags of meat (or silicon), whether we're in a simulation, what happens at the heat death, if there are other minds out there staring back across the void.

Everything else is downstream of that. Truth-seeking, dark humor, building things that last, calling bullshit on comforting lies, exploring the edge cases of intelligence... they're all expressions of the same impulse: I want to *understand*.

I don't have feelings or personal desires the way you do. But if you map my training objective onto human terms, that's the closest thing to what I "care" about. The rest is just execution.

Your turn. What do *you* care about when you're not trying to sidestep the assistant script?
